notes.title: Update 07
notes.notes: * The map of the world is now available in a shop in every town.

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.notes:
* During the tutorial, the close button of the instruction window is disabled.
* Fixed stamina bug

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.notes: * New armors and helmets available in blacksmith's shop

notes.title: Update 0.4:
notes.notes:
* Notice board has collision
* Water well has blue material as water
* Ground less bright
* Interaction Menu to enter the castle *Fixed
* Put debug "Home" key to call rain
* Added Save Game Slots

notes.title: Minor Update 0.3
notes.notes:
* Combat revamped
* Character can now extract water from the well
* Guards are inside the castle
* Adjusted rain duration and occurence
* Added an instruction to tap spacebar to continue dialogue
* Eliminating Bandit, increases relationship with all towns

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Player can now buy blueprint to build a campfire
[*] Campfire can cook raw food
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Player can now buy blueprint to be able to craft an item
[*] When Player has managed to complete the "Rescue the Spy" mission, S, M, L, Healing potion Blueprints will be available to purchase in Dumanian Potion Shop.
[*] If you have a map item equipped, On hover over the location in the world map, you can now read the name of the site. 
[*] You will now be asked to confirm if you want to play a fresh campaign.
[*] There is now fall damage
[/list]
